items.title: NEAR Opens Vote to Cut Token Issuance to 1.6%
items.summary: HSP-029 would lower issuance over 24 months after a 90-day grace period, but validators must separately adopt a network upgrade.

items.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
items.summary: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

items.title: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
U.S. CFTC sets agenda for AI forum, exploring trading and agentic finance
items.summary: A Commodity Futures Trading Commission task force is scheduled for October 28 to talk about how the latest "super intelligence" technology may impact markets.
